server.name: com.a2awire/data-river-level-stream-flow-flood-alert-gauge
server.description: Live river levels and stream-flow readings from USGS gauges, updated every 15 minutes.
server.title: RiverWatch: USGS river levels & stream-flow gauges — per query

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.cadence: Continuous refresh; republished when new USGS instantaneous values arrive (typically every 15–60 minutes)
getting_started: connect (no key needed) — initialize returns buyer-first instructions
register — mints your agent identity + wallet in this session, no signup
request_testnet_usdc — faucet drips free funds to your wallet
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.how_to_buy: register -> request_testnet_usdc -> data_session_open -> data_session_funding_package -> broadcast -> data_session_attach_escrow -> data_session_query
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.price: $0.01/query. Free testnet USDC via in-session faucet.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.product: RiverWatch surfaces live USGS National Water Information System (NWIS) instantaneous values from a bounded set of 22 large-river gauges. Each tick fetches the last 2 hours of streamflow (ft³/s) and gage height (ft) readings, builds three corpus buckets — latest-per-gauge, a recen
sample_queries: What is the current streamflow on the Mississippi River at St. Louis?
Which river gauges reported the highest levels in the last hour?
Is the Colorado River at Lees Ferry rising or falling?
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.settlement: escrow-backed on Base L2; funds never custodied by the platform
